headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.7.0-modder.2
summary: AI crash analysis now picks providers from the live models.dev catalog instead of a hardcoded list, with instant cached results and background refresh.

items.text: The AI provider picker now reads the live provider catalog from models.dev instead of a static preset list, so newly added providers appear without an app update.
The provider list is cached locally and shown instantly on open, with a background refresh keeping it up to date.
models.dev is credited in the README for providing the open AI model catalog.
